title: Contract modifications: editorial notes and questions
summary: Read the surrounding notes and questions alongside the principal cases. The complete assigned pages are preserved here.
notes:
Alaska Packers’ Association v. Domenico: It connects consideration to contract modification and shows why a promise to pay more for unchanged performance can raise both an exchange problem and a coercion problem.

Watkins & Son v. Carrig: It supplies a contrasting judicial response to the pre-existing-duty rule and makes the distinction between an assumed original risk and an enforceable later adjustment explicit.

Austin Instrument, Inc. v. Loral Corporation: It explains what must be shown in addition to a threat of breach: practical inability to replace the promised performance and an inadequate damages remedy.
